note: Parameters below were fixed a priori from existing system thresholds and documented rationale and were NOT tuned on any ground truth. Any later change must be a new config_version with ALL variants reported.
status_factor_rationale: Q40 excludes non-SUPPORTED records entirely. Challenged evidence is under documented dispute, so it keeps half weight; invalidated/superseded evidence is never treated as current support (0).
missing_reliability_rationale: A record with no linked evidence has unknown provenance; the neutral midpoint 0.5 neither rewards nor erases it. Q40 effectively uses 1.0.

q40r.weights_rationale: identical to frozen Q40 so that only the reliability treatment differs

raeer.expansion: Reliability-Aware Evidence Evolution Ranking (name from the project's Part 7 specification; the formula is defined in research/phase4/docs/RAEER_DEFINITION.md because no mathematical definition existed)
raeer.weights_rationale: same weights as Q40 by design: differences from Q40 come from feature definitions, not from re-weighting
raeer.scene_radius_rationale: threshold of the existing INCIDENT_PROXIMITY_001 correlation rule
raeer.temporal_tau_rationale: half of the 60-minute incident window: evidence at the incident time counts fully, evidence at the window edge about e^-2

contradiction.rationale: distance from CONTRADICTION_001; gamma<1 so a contradiction can lower but never erase support (contradiction is not proof of innocence)
